sources.title: Instruction-Following Evaluation for Large Language Models
sources.snippet: In this paper, we introduce IFEval, a new approach for evaluating the proficiency of language models in instruction following. The metric centers around a distinct category of instructions termed "verifiable instructions", which are defined as instructions amenable to objective verification of compliance (Figure 1). sources.snippet: ABSTRACT One core capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) is to follow natural lan-guage instructions. However, the evaluation of such abilities is not standardized: Human evaluations are expensive, slow, and not objectively reproducible, while LLM-based auto-evaluation is potentially biased or limited by the ability of the evaluator LLM.
